title: Pharmacoinformatics approach for the screening of Kovidra (Bauhinia variegata) phytoconstituents against tumor suppressor protein in triple negative breast cancer.
authors: More-Adate, Pallavi; Lokhande, Kiran Bharat; Shrivastava, Ashish; Doiphode, Sayali; Nagar, Shuchi; Singh, Ashutosh; Baheti, Akshay
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟筛选植物化合物与p53蛋白的结合，但对象是蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Globally, 2.3 million women were diagnosed with breast cancer, with 6,85000 mortalities in year 2021; making it the world's most prevalent cancer. This growing global burden necessitates a new treatment option, and plant-based medicines offers a promising alternative to conventional cancer treatment. In this work, screening of phytoconstituents of an indigenous therapeutic plant, Bauhinia variegata carried out for potential regulator of tumor suppressor protein p53. Here, an in-silico analysis was employed to develop more effective, pharmaceutically potent small drug-like compounds that target tumor suppressor protein p53. The methanol and aqueous powdered extracts of Bauhinia variegata were prepared and phytochemically evaluated along with antioxidant property evaluation. The LC(50) of methanol (325.33 microg/ml) and aqueous extract (361.15 microg/ml) showed their cytotoxic characteristics. Further, GCMS analysis of both the extracts reveals total 57 secondary metabolites. Among these, four lead compounds; compound 1, compound 2, compound 3 and compound 4 were found to have the highest binding ability (-8.15 to -5.40 kcal/mol) with p53. MD simulation and binding free energy validates these findings with highest binding free energy (-67.09 +/- 4.87 kcal/mol) towards p53 by the lead phytocompound 2. Selected compounds exhibit excellent pharmacokinetic features and drug-like characteristics. The acute toxicity (LD(50)) values of the lead phytocompounds ranges from 670 mg/kg to 3100 mg/kg, with toxicity classes of IV and V. As a result, these druggable phytochemicals could serve as potential lead applicants for triple negative breast cancer treatment. However, more in vitro and in vivo research is planned to produce future breast cancer medicine. Among these, four lead compounds were found to have the highest binding affinity (-8.153 to -5.401 kcal/mol) with tumor suppressor protein p53.MD simulation along with the Prime MM/GBSA binding free energy validates this discovery with highest binding free energy (-67.09 +/- 4.87 kcal/mol) towards p53 by the lead compound 2.The acute toxicity (LD(50)) values of the lead phytocompounds ranges from 670 mg/kg to 3100 mg/kg, with toxicity classes of IV and V.As a result, these druggable phytochemicals could serve as potential lead applicants for triple negative breast cancer treatment.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. abstract_zh: 全球范围内，2021年有230万名女性被诊断出患有乳腺癌，其中685000人死亡，使其成为全球最常见的癌症。这一日益增长的全球负担需要新的治疗方案，而植物源药物为传统癌症治疗提供了一种有前景的替代方案。本研究对本土药用植物紫荆花（Bauhinia variegata）的植物化学成分进行了筛选，以寻找肿瘤抑制蛋白p53的潜在调控因子。此处，采用计算机模拟分析来开发更有效、具有药物潜力的类药小分子化合物，以靶向肿瘤抑制蛋白p53。制备了紫荆花的甲醇和水提粉末提取物，并对其进行了植物化学评估及抗氧化性能评价。甲醇提取物（325.33微克/毫升）和水提物（361.15微克/毫升）的LC(50)值显示了其细胞毒性特征。此外，对两种提取物的GCMS分析共揭示了57种次生代谢产物。其中，四种先导化合物——化合物1、化合物2、化合物3和化合物4——被发现与p53具有最高的结合能力（-8.15至-5.40千卡/摩尔）。分子动力学模拟和结合自由能验证了这些发现，其中先导植物化合物2对p53具有最高的结合自由能（-67.09 ± 4.87千卡/摩尔）。所选化合物表现出优异的药代动力学特性和类药特征。先导植物化合物的急性毒性（LD(50)）值范围为670毫克/千克至3100毫克/千克，毒性类别为IV和V类。因此，这些可成药的植物化学物质可能作为三阴性乳腺癌治疗的潜在先导候选物。然而，计划进行更多的体外和体内研究，以开发未来的乳腺癌药物。亮点：对本土药用植物紫荆花（Bauhinia variegata）的植物化学成分进行筛选，寻找肿瘤抑制蛋白p53的潜在调控因子。甲醇提取物（325.33微克/毫升）和水提物（361.15微克/毫升）的LC(50)值显示了其细胞毒性特征。对两种提取物的GCMS分析共揭示了57种次生代谢产物。其中，四种先导化合物被发现与肿瘤抑制蛋白p53具有最高的结合亲和力（-8.153至-5.401千卡/摩尔）。分子动力学模拟结合Prime MM/GBSA结合自由能验证了这一发现，其中先导化合物2对p53具有最高的结合自由能（-67.09 ± 4.87千卡/摩尔）。先导植物化合物的急性毒性（LD(50)）值范围为670毫克/千克至3100毫克/千克，毒性类别为IV和V类。因此，这些可成药的植物化学物质可能作为三阴性乳腺癌治疗的潜在先导候选物。由Ramaswamy H.
